items.source:
--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- DELIVERY SERVICE · el bucle principal
-- Recibir entrega → modificador → ruta → entregar → dinero → repetir
-- Multijugador: cada jugador tiene su propia sesión simultánea.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Packages = require(Shared.Packages)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)

local Server = script.Parent
local EconomyService = require(Server.EconomyService)
local UpgradeService = require(Server.UpgradeService)
local PackageEffects = require(Server.PackageEffects)

local DeliveryService = {}
local rng = Random.new()
local sessions = {} -- [player] = session
local nextSessionId = 0
DeliveryService.Sessions = sessions

local function popup(player, kind, title, lines)
	Remotes.DeliveryPopup:FireClient(player, { Kind = kind, Title = title, Lines = lines or {} })
end
DeliveryService.Popup = popup

local function getDestinations()
	local list, seen = {}, {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("DeliveryDestination")) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") and not seen[inst] then
			seen[inst] = true
			table.insert(list, inst)
		end
	end
	-- alternativa sin tags: carpeta workspace.Destinations
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Destinations")
	if folder then
		for _, inst in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") and not seen[inst] then
				seen[inst] = true
				table.insert(list, inst)
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ASIGNAR ENTREGA
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.Assign(player)
	if sessions[player] then
		popup(player, "Info", "📦 ENTREGA EN CURSO", { "Termina tu entrega actual primero." })
		return
	end
	local dests = getDestinations()
	if #dests == 0 then
		popup(player, "Info", "⚠️ SIN DESTINOS", { "No hay destinos en la ciudad." })
		warn("[Delivery] No se encontraron destinos (tag 'DeliveryDestination' o carpeta workspace.Destinations)")
		return
	end

	local dest = dests[rng:NextInteger(1, #dests)]
	-- ⭐ la reputación desbloquea paquetes más difíciles (y mejor pagados)
	local rep = EconomyService.GetReputation(player)
	local pkg = Packages.PickForRep(rng, rep)
	nextSessionId += 1

	local session = {
		Id = nextSessionId,
		Package = pkg,
		Destination = dest,
		EndsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + pkg.Time,
		State = "Active", -- Active | Dropped | ChickenOut
		Threads = {},
		Connections = {},
	}
	sessions[player] = session

	-- 🐌 PESADO: la mochila reduce la penalización
	if pkg.Id == "Heavy" then
		local bp = UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Backpack")
		player:SetAttribute("SpeedMult", 1 - 0.3 * (1 - 0.25 * bp))
	else
		player:SetAttribute("SpeedMult", 1)
	end

	-- ❤️ FRÁGIL: resistencia según mejora
	if pkg.Id == "Fragile" then
		session.Health = 2 + UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Resistance")
		player:SetAttribute("DeliveryHealth", session.Health)
	else
		player:SetAttribute("DeliveryHealth", -1)
	end

	PackageEffects.Attach(player, pkg)

	-- atributos replicados para el HUD del cliente
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryState", "Active")
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryPackage", pkg.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryPackageIcon", pkg.Icon)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryDifficulty", pkg.Difficulty or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryPackageDesc", pkg.Desc)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryDestName", dest.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryDestPos", dest.Position)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryEndsAt", session.EndsAt)

	-- ⏱️ temporizador del servidor (anti-trampas)
	local id = session.Id
	table.insert(session.Threads, task.delay(pkg.Time + 0.3, function()
		local s = sessions[player]
		if s and s.Id == id and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= s.EndsAt - 0.05 then
			DeliveryService.Fail(player, "⏱️ Se acabó el tiempo")
		end
	end))

	-- 🐔 CHICKEN PACKAGE: el pollo puede escapar a mitad de entrega
	if pkg.Id == "Chicken" then
		table.insert(session.Threads, task.delay(rng:NextNumber(12, 30), function()
			local s = sessions[player]
			if s and s.Id == id and s.State == "Active" then
				DeliveryService.ChickenEscape(player)
			end
		end))
	end

	-- si el personaje muere, la entrega falla
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		table.insert(session.Connections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
			local s = sessions[player]
			if s and s.Id == id then
				DeliveryService.Fail(player, "💀 Caíste en el camino")
			end
		end))
	end

	popup(player, "Assigned", pkg.Icon .. " PACKAGE #" .. id, {
		"📍 Destino: " .. dest.Name,
		"⏱️ " .. pkg.Time .. " SEGUNDOS",
		"⭐ Dificultad " .. (pkg.Difficulty or 1) .. " · " .. string.upper(pkg.Name),
		pkg.Desc,
	})
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- GOLPES (llamado por PackageEffects vía OnHardHit)
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.RegisterHit(player)
	local s = sessions[player]
	if not s or s.State ~= "Active" then return end

	if s.Package.Id == "Explosive" then
		-- 💣 los golpes PUEDEN provocar explosión; Resistencia reduce la probabilidad
		local res = UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Resistance")
		if rng:NextNumber() < (0.55 - 0.12 * res) then
			PackageEffects.Explode(player)
			DeliveryService.Fail(player, "💥 BOOM. El paquete explotó.")
		else
			popup(player, "Info", "💣 ¡CUIDADO!", { "El paquete estuvo a punto de explotar." })
		end
	elseif s.Package.Id == "Fragile" then
		-- ❤️ el paquete aguanta unos golpes
		s.Health = (s.Health or 1) - 1
		player:SetAttribute("DeliveryHealth", s.Health)
		if s.Health <= 0 then
			DeliveryService.Fail(player, "💔 El paquete se rompió")
		else
			popup(player, "Info", "❤️ PAQUETE DAÑADO", { "Le quedan " .. s.Health .. " golpes." })
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SOLTAR / RECUPERAR PAQUETE (perros, drones, anomalía…)
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.DropPackage(player, cause)
	local s = sessions[player]
	if not s or s.State ~= "Active" then return end

	-- 🎒 la mochila puede evitar que lo sueltes
	local bp = UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Backpack")
	if bp > 0 and rng:NextNumber() < 0.25 * bp then
		popup(player, "Info", "🎒 ¡BUENA MOCHILA!", { "Tu mochila evitó que soltaras el paquete." })
		return
	end

	s.State = "Dropped"
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryState", "Dropped")
	PackageEffects.DropToGround(player, function()
		local ss = sessions[player]
		if ss and ss.State == "Dropped" then
			ss.State = "Active"
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryState", "Active")
			popup(player, "Info", "📦 PAQUETE RECUPERADO", { "¡Sigue corriendo!" })
		end
	end)
	popup(player, "Info", "📦 ¡PAQUETE AL SUELO!", { "Recógelo antes de que acabe el tiempo." })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🐔 EL POLLO ESCAPA
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.ChickenEscape(player)
	local s = sessions[player]
	if not s then return end
	s.State = "ChickenOut"
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryState", "ChickenOut")
	PackageEffects.SetPackageVisible(player, false)

	local HazardService = require(Server.HazardService) -- require perezoso (evita ciclo)
	HazardService.SpawnChicken(player, function()
		local ss = sessions[player]
		if ss and ss.State == "ChickenOut" then
			ss.State = "Active"
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryState", "Active")
			PackageEffects.SetPackageVisible(player, true)
			popup(player, "Info", "🐔 ¡POLLO ATRAPADO!", { "El paquete vuelve a tus manos." })
		end
	end)
	popup(player, "Info", "🐔 ¡EL POLLO ESCAPÓ!", { "Atrápalo para recuperar el paquete." })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ENTREGAR
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.TryDeliver(player, destPart)
	local s = sessions[player]
	if not s then
		popup(player, "Info", "📦 SIN ENTREGA", { "Recoge un paquete en la tienda primero." })
		return
	end
	if s.Destination ~= destPart then
		popup(player, "Info", "🧭 DESTINO INCORRECTO", { "Tu paquete va a: " .. s.Destination.Name })
		return
	end
	if s.State == "Dropped" then
		popup(player, "Info", "📦 FALTA EL PAQUETE", { "¡Recoge tu paquete del suelo primero!" })
		return
	end
	if s.State == "ChickenOut" then
		popup(player, "Info", "🐔 FALTA EL POLLO", { "¡Atrapa el pollo primero!" })
		return
	end
	-- validación anti-teletransporte
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp or (hrp.Position - destPart.Position).Magnitude > 30 then
		popup(player, "Info", "📍 MUY LEJOS", { "Acércate al punto de entrega." })
		return
	end

	local remaining = math.max(0, s.EndsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	local base = s.Package.Pay
	local timeBonus = math.floor(remaining) * Config.TimeBonusPerSecond
	local subtotal = base + timeBonus
	local diff = s.Package.Difficulty or 1

	-- ⭐ reputación: bonus de paga según reputación actual + puntos al entregar
	local oldRep = EconomyService.GetReputation(player)
	local repBonus = math.floor(subtotal * oldRep * Config.Reputation.PayBonusPerPoint)
	local total = subtotal + repBonus
	local repGain = Config.Reputation.SuccessPerDifficulty * diff
	EconomyService.AddMoney(player, total)
	local newRep = EconomyService.AddReputation(player, repGain)
	local leveledUp, newLevel = EconomyService.AddXP(player, Config.XPPerDelivery + math.floor(remaining * Config.XPPerSecondLeft))
	EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	DeliveryService.Cleanup(player, s)

	local lines = {
		"+$" .. base,
		"TIME BONUS +$" .. timeBonus,
		"⭐ REPUTACIÓN +$" .. repBonus .. "  (Rep +" .. repGain .. ")",
	}
	if (oldRep < 40 and newRep >= 40) or (oldRep < 70 and newRep >= 70) then
		table.insert(lines, "🌟 ¡NUEVAS OFERTAS! Paquetes más difíciles y mejor pagados.")
	end
	if leveledUp then
		table.insert(lines, "🏆 ¡SUBISTE A NIVEL " .. newLevel .. "!")
	end
	popup(player, "Success", "🎉 DELIVERY SUCCESS!", lines)
	DeliveryService.ScheduleNext(player)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- FALLO
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.Fail(player, reason)
	local s = sessions[player]
	if not s then return end
	-- ⭐ perder el pedido (o que expire el tiempo) baja reputación según dificultad
	local diff = s.Package.Difficulty or 1
	local repLoss = Config.Reputation.FailPerDifficulty * diff
	EconomyService.AddReputation(player, -repLoss)
	EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	DeliveryService.Cleanup(player, s)
	popup(player, "Fail", "❌ ENTREGA FALLIDA", { reason, "⭐ Reputación −" .. repLoss })
	DeliveryService.ScheduleNext(player)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SIGUIENTE ENTREGA AUTOMÁTICA
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.ScheduleNext(player)
	if not Config.AutoNextDelivery then return end
	task.delay(Config.NextDeliveryDelay, function()
		if player.Parent and player.Character and not sessions[player] then
			popup(player, "Info", "📦 NEXT DELIVERY", { "Nueva entrega asignada…" })
			DeliveryService.Assign(player)
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPIEZA
------------------------------------------------------------
function DeliveryService.Cleanup(player, session)
	session = session or sessions[player]
	if not session then return end
	for _, t in ipairs(session.Threads) do
		pcall(task.cancel, t)
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(session.Connections) do
		pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
	end
	PackageEffects.Detach(player)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryState", "None")
	player:SetAttribute("SpeedMult", 1)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryHealth", -1)
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryEndsAt", 0)
	sessions[player] = nil
end

return DeliveryService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- ECONOMY SERVICE · dinero, XP, niveles y guardado (DataStore)
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local EconomyService = {}

local dataStore
pcall(function()
	dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("Delivery60s_v1")
end)

local cache = {} -- [userId] = data

local function defaultData()
	return {
		Money = Config.StartMoney,
		XP = 0,
		Reputation = Config.Reputation.Start,
		Upgrades = { Speed = 0, Stamina = 0, Resistance = 0, Backpack = 0, GPS = 0 },
		Vehicles = { [Config.StartingVehicle] = true },
	}
end

function EconomyService.LevelForXP(xp)
	return math.floor(xp / Config.XPPerLevel) + 1
end

function EconomyService.GetData(player)
	return cache[player.UserId]
end

function EconomyService.LoadPlayer(player)
	local data = defaultData()
	if dataStore then
		local ok, saved = pcall(function()
			return dataStore:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok and type(saved) == "table" then
			-- fusionar con valores por defecto (por si añadimos campos nuevos)
			local def = defaultData()
			for k, v in def do
				if saved[k] == nil then saved[k] = v end
			end
			if type(saved.Upgrades) ~= "table" then saved.Upgrades = def.Upgrades end
			for k, v in def.Upgrades do
				if saved.Upgrades[k] == nil then saved.Upgrades[k] = v end
			end
			if type(saved.Vehicles) ~= "table" then saved.Vehicles = def.Vehicles end
			data = saved
		else
			if not ok then
				warn("[Economy] No se pudieron cargar los datos de " .. player.Name .. " (¿Studio API access activado?)")
			end
		end
	end
	cache[player.UserId] = data

	-- leaderstats visibles en el marcador de Roblox
	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	ls.Parent = player

	local money = Instance.new("IntValue")
	money.Name = "Money"
	money.Value = data.Money
	money.Parent = ls

	local xp = Instance.new("IntValue")
	xp.Name = "XP"
	xp.Value = data.XP
	xp.Parent = ls

	local level = Instance.new("IntValue")
	level.Name = "Level"
	level.Value = EconomyService.LevelForXP(data.XP)
	level.Parent = ls

	local rep = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rep.Name = "Rep"
	rep.Value = data.Reputation
	rep.Parent = ls

	player:SetAttribute("Money", data.Money)
	player:SetAttribute("Reputation", data.Reputation)
end

function EconomyService.AddMoney(player, amount)
	local data = cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return 0 end
	data.Money = math.max(0, data.Money + amount)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Money") then
		ls.Money.Value = data.Money
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Money", data.Money)
	return data.Money
end

function EconomyService.SpendMoney(player, amount)
	local data = cache[player.UserId]
	if not data or data.Money < amount then
		return false
	end
	EconomyService.AddMoney(player, -amount)
	return true
end

-- Devuelve (subióDeNivel, nuevoNivel)
function EconomyService.AddXP(player, amount)
	local data = cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return false, 1 end
	local oldLevel = EconomyService.LevelForXP(data.XP)
	data.XP += amount
	local newLevel = EconomyService.LevelForXP(data.XP)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls then
		if ls:FindFirstChild("XP") then ls.XP.Value = data.XP end
		if ls:FindFirstChild("Level") then ls.Level.Value = newLevel end
	end
	return newLevel > oldLevel, newLevel
end

function EconomyService.GetReputation(player)
	local data = cache[player.UserId]
	return (data and data.Reputation) or Config.Reputation.Start
end

-- Suma/resta reputación (limitada a Min-Max). Devuelve el nuevo valor.
function EconomyService.AddReputation(player, delta)
	local data = cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return Config.Reputation.Start end
	local current = data.Reputation or Config.Reputation.Start
	data.Reputation = math.clamp(current + delta, Config.Reputation.Min, Config.Reputation.Max)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Rep") then
		ls.Rep.Value = data.Reputation
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Reputation", data.Reputation)
	return data.Reputation
end

function EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	local data = cache[player.UserId]
	if not data or not dataStore then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		dataStore:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, data)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Economy] Error guardando datos de " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

function EconomyService.SaveAll()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	end
end

function EconomyService.UnloadPlayer(player)
	cache[player.UserId] = nil
end

return EconomyService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- ENTITY SPAWNER · crea entidades a partir de DOS fuentes:
--   1) Plantilla del usuario: ServerStorage/DeliveryModels/<Tipo>
--      (tu modelo 3D de la Toolbox o tuyo; si está vacío, se rellenan
--      bloques placeholder automáticamente)
--   2) Runtime: modelo nuevo con bloques placeholder
-- En ambos casos el comportamiento (Behaviors/<Tipo>) se arranca aquí;
-- si el modelo trae su propio Script bootstrap, un guard interno evita
-- que el comportamiento se ejecute dos veces.
--============================================================
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local EntitySpawner = {}

local BEHAVIOR_ALIAS = { -- modelos que comparten comportamiento
	Bike = "Vehicle", Scooter = "Vehicle", Moto = "Vehicle", Car = "Vehicle",
}

local function behaviorModuleFor(kind)
	local folder = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("Behaviors")
	if not folder then return nil end
	local name = BEHAVIOR_ALIAS[kind] or kind
	return folder:FindFirstChild(name)
end

-- EntitySpawner.Spawn(tipo, atributos?, cframe?) → Model
function EntitySpawner.Spawn(kind, attrs, cframe)
	attrs = attrs or {}

	-- ¿hay plantilla utilizable del usuario?
	local templates = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("DeliveryModels")
	local template = templates and templates:FindFirstChild(kind)
	local usable = template and (
		template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) ~= nil
		or template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Script", true) ~= nil
	)

	local model
	if usable then
		model = template:Clone()
	else
		model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = kind
		PlaceholderBuilder.Build(kind, model)
	end

	-- configuración por atributos (los comportamientos los leen)
	for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
		model:SetAttribute(k, v)
	end

	-- si el modelo del usuario no tiene PrimaryPart, elegir la parte mayor
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
	end

	if cframe and model.PrimaryPart then
		model:PivotTo(cframe)
	end
	model.Parent = workspace

	-- arrancar comportamiento (guard "BehaviorRunning" evita duplicados
	-- cuando el modelo ya trae su Script bootstrap)
	local module = behaviorModuleFor(kind)
	if module then
		local m = module
		task.spawn(function()
			require(m).Run(model)
		end)
	end

	return model
end

return EntitySpawner

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- EVENT SERVICE · eventos ocasionales de la ciudad
-- 🌧️ Tormenta · 🚦 Caos de tráfico · 🌑 Blackout · 🌀 Paradox
-- 🚧 Construction · 👻 Anomalía
-- Los coches y las cajas usan modelos de ServerStorage/DeliveryModels
-- (o bloques placeholder si no hay plantilla).
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local CityEvents = require(Shared.CityEvents)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)

local Server = script.Parent
local HazardService = require(Server.HazardService)
local DeliveryService = require(Server.DeliveryService)
local EntitySpawner = require(Server.EntitySpawner)

local EventService = {}
local rng = Random.new()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Implementación de cada evento (devuelve función de reversión)
------------------------------------------------------------
local activators = {}

-- 🌧️ TORMENTA: niebla densa y ambiente oscuro
activators.Storm = function()
	local old = {
		FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
		FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
		OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
	}
	Lighting.FogStart = 0
	Lighting.FogEnd = 260
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 82)
	return function()
		Lighting.FogStart = old.FogStart
		Lighting.FogEnd = old.FogEnd
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = old.OutdoorAmbient
	end
end

-- 🌑 BLACKOUT: se apagan las luces
activators.Blackout = function()
	local old = {
		ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
		OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
		Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
	}
	Lighting.ClockTime = 0
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 22)
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 30)
	local lights = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("StreetLight")) do
		local light = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
		if light and light.Enabled then
			light.Enabled = false
			table.insert(lights, light)
		end
	end
	return function()
		Lighting.ClockTime = old.ClockTime
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = old.OutdoorAmbient
		Lighting.Ambient = old.Ambient
		for _, light in ipairs(lights) do
			if light.Parent then light.Enabled = true end
		end
	end
end

-- 🚦 CAOS DE TRÁFICO: coches bloqueando las calles
activators.TrafficChaos = function(duration)
	local pathsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("TrafficPaths")
	local conns = {}
	if pathsFolder then
		for _, path in ipairs(pathsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			local a = path:FindFirstChild("A")
			local b = path:FindFirstChild("B")
			if a and b then
				for i = 1, 2 do
					local startCF = CFrame.new(a.Position:Lerp(b.Position, rng:NextNumber()))
					local car = EntitySpawner.Spawn("TrafficCar", {
						WaypointA = a.Position,
						WaypointB = b.Position,
						Speed = 32,
						LifeTime = duration,
					}, startCF)
					table.insert(conns, car:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CaughtTick"):Connect(function()
						local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(car:GetAttribute("CaughtUserId") or 0)
						if plr and car.PrimaryPart then
							HazardService.Trip(plr, car.PrimaryPart.Position)
							DeliveryService.DropPackage(plr, "car")
						end
					end))
					Debris:AddItem(car, duration)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return function()
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
	end
end

-- 🌀 PARADOX: una parte de la ciudad cambia (se abre una ruta bloqueada)
activators.Paradox = function()
	local gate
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("ParadoxGate")) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			gate = inst
			break
		end
	end
	local oldAmbient = Lighting.Ambient
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 170)
	if not gate then
		return function() Lighting.Ambient = oldAmbient end
	end
	local oldCF, oldTrans, oldCollide = gate.CFrame, gate.Transparency, gate.CanCollide
	gate.CanCollide = false
	local tween = TweenService:Create(gate, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		CFrame = oldCF * CFrame.new(0, 16, 0),
		Transparency = 0.6,
	})
	tween:Play()
	return function()
		Lighting.Ambient = oldAmbient
		if gate.Parent then
			local back = TweenService:Create(gate, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				CFrame = oldCF,
				Transparency = oldTrans,
			})
			back:Play()
			back.Completed:Connect(function()
				if gate.Parent then gate.CanCollide = oldCollide end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- 🚧 CONSTRUCTION: aparecen obstáculos… y una rampa (nueva ruta)
activators.Construction = function(duration)
	local spawned = {}
	for _, node in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("ConstructionNode")) do
		if node:IsA("BasePart") then
			-- dos cajas obstáculo (plantilla "Crate" o bloque placeholder)
			for i = 1, 2 do
				local crate = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Crate", nil,
					node.CFrame * CFrame.new(rng:NextNumber(-6, 6), 2, rng:NextNumber(-6, 6)))
				table.insert(spawned, crate)
				Debris:AddItem(crate, duration)
			end
			-- una rampa = nueva ruta temporal
			local ramp = Instance.new("WedgePart")
			ramp.Name = "ConstructionRamp"
			ramp.Size = Vector3.new(8, 5, 10)
			ramp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 155)
			ramp.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
			ramp.Anchored = true
			ramp.CFrame = node.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 12) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rng:NextInteger(0, 3) * 90), 0)
			ramp.Parent = workspace
			table.insert(spawned, ramp)
			Debris:AddItem(ramp, duration)
		end
	end
	return function()
		for _, p in ipairs(spawned) do
			if p.Parent then p:Destroy() end
		end
	end
end

-- 👻 ANOMALÍA: algo persigue a los repartidores
activators.Anomaly = function(duration)
	HazardService.SpawnAnomaly(duration)
	return function() end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUCLE DE EVENTOS (ocasionales: cada 75-140 s)
------------------------------------------------------------
function EventService.Start()
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(30) -- respiro inicial
		while true do
			local def = CityEvents.Pick(rng)
			local activate = activators[def.Id]
			if activate then
				local revert = activate(def.Duration)
				Remotes.EventAnnounce:FireAllClients(def.Icon, def.Name, def.Desc, def.Duration)
				print("[Evento] " .. def.Name .. " (" .. def.Duration .. "s)")
				task.delay(def.Duration, function()
					pcall(revert)
				end)
			end
			task.wait(rng:NextNumber(75, 140))
		end
	end)
end

return EventService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- HAZARD SERVICE · peligros que interrumpen tu ruta
-- 🐕 perros · 🦹 ladrones · 🚁 drones · 🐔 pollo · 👻 anomalía
--
-- Cada peligro es un MODELO (ServerStorage/DeliveryModels/<Tipo>)
-- con comportamiento autocontenido (Behaviors/<Tipo>). Si la
-- plantilla no existe o está vacía, se usan bloques placeholder.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Server = script.Parent
local EconomyService = require(Server.EconomyService)
local DeliveryService = require(Server.DeliveryService)
local EntitySpawner = require(Server.EntitySpawner)

local HazardService = {}
local rng = Random.new()
local activeCounts = {} -- [player] = peligros activos

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Utilidades
------------------------------------------------------------

-- Hace tropezar al jugador (sin daño)
function HazardService.Trip(player, sourcePos)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum then return end
	local dir = (hrp.Position - sourcePos)
	dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
	dir = dir.Unit + Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0)
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
	hrp:ApplyImpulse(dir * hrp.AssemblyMass * 22)
end

local function rootPos(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

local function randomSpawnPos(center, minR, maxR)
	local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
	local dist = rng:NextNumber(minR, maxR)
	return center + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, 0, math.sin(angle) * dist)
end

local function count(player, delta)
	activeCounts[player] = math.max(0, (activeCounts[player] or 0) + delta)
end

-- Escucha el atributo de salida "CaughtTick" del modelo
local function watchCaught(model, fn)
	local conn
	conn = model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CaughtTick"):Connect(function()
		fn(model:GetAttribute("CaughtUserId"))
	end)
	model.Destroying:Connect(function()
		conn:Disconnect()
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🐕 PERRO: persigue, hace tropezar y suelta el paquete
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnDog(player)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	count(player, 1)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Dog", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, Speed = 22, CatchDist = 3.5, LifeTime = 18,
	}, CFrame.new(randomSpawnPos(pos, 22, 30)))
	model.Destroying:Connect(function() count(player, -1) end)
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if p and model.PrimaryPart then
			HazardService.Trip(p, model.PrimaryPart.Position)
			DeliveryService.DropPackage(p, "dog")
		end
	end)
	DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "🐕 DOG ATTACK", { "¡Un perro te persigue!" })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🦹 LADRÓN: roba dinero (más probable con Público/Valioso)
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnThief(player)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	count(player, 1)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Thief", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, Speed = 20, CatchDist = 3.5, LifeTime = 16,
	}, CFrame.new(randomSpawnPos(pos, 24, 32)))
	model.Destroying:Connect(function() count(player, -1) end)
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		local data = p and EconomyService.GetData(p)
		if p and data then
			local stolen = math.min(math.floor(data.Money * 0.1), 100)
			if stolen > 0 then
				EconomyService.AddMoney(p, -stolen)
				DeliveryService.Popup(p, "Fail", "🦹 ¡TE ROBARON!", { "-$" .. stolen })
			else
				DeliveryService.Popup(p, "Info", "🦹 LADRÓN", { "No tenías dinero que robar…" })
			end
		end
	end)
	DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "🦹 ¡LADRÓN!", { "Quiere tu dinero. Aléjate." })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🚁 DRONE: te hace soltar el paquete
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnDrone(player)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	count(player, 1)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Drone", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, Speed = 30, CatchDist = 4, LifeTime = 12,
	}, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-15, 15), 10, rng:NextNumber(-15, 15))))
	model.Destroying:Connect(function() count(player, -1) end)
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if p then
			DeliveryService.DropPackage(p, "drone")
		end
	end)
	DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "🚁 DRONE", { "Un drone de seguridad te sigue…" })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🐔 POLLO: escapa y hay que atraparlo (solo el dueño)
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnChicken(player, onCaught)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Chicken", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, LifeTime = 40,
	}, CFrame.new(randomSpawnPos(pos, 8, 14)))
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		if userId == player.UserId then
			onCaught()
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 👻 ANOMALÍA (evento): persigue al repartidor más cercano
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnAnomaly(duration)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Anomaly", {
		Speed = 24, CatchDist = 4.5, LifeTime = duration,
	}, CFrame.new(0, 4, 0))
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if p and model.PrimaryPart then
			HazardService.Trip(p, model.PrimaryPart.Position)
			DeliveryService.DropPackage(p, "anomaly")
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUCLE AMBIENTE: peligros ocasionales para repartidores activos
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.Start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(12)
			for player, session in pairs(DeliveryService.Sessions) do
				if player.Parent and (activeCounts[player] or 0) == 0 then
					local pkgId = session.Package.Id
					local roll = rng:NextNumber()
					if roll < 0.10 then
						HazardService.SpawnDog(player)
					elseif roll < 0.16 + ((pkgId == "Public" or pkgId == "Valuable") and 0.14 or 0) then
						HazardService.SpawnThief(player)
					elseif roll < 0.22 then
						HazardService.SpawnDrone(player)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function HazardService.Cleanup(player)
	activeCounts[player] = nil
end

return HazardService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- MAIN · Delivery: 60 Seconds
-- Arranque del juego: conecta todos los servicios.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)

local Server = script.Parent
local MapBuilder = require(Server.MapBuilder)
local EconomyService = require(Server.EconomyService)
local UpgradeService = require(Server.UpgradeService)
local DeliveryService = require(Server.DeliveryService)
local PackageEffects = require(Server.PackageEffects)
local VehicleService = require(Server.VehicleService)
local EventService = require(Server.EventService)
local HazardService = require(Server.HazardService)

print("[Delivery60] Iniciando servidor…")

-- 🗺️ ciudad de prueba (si está activada en Config)
MapBuilder.Build()

-- 🧩 Plantillas de modelos 3D: crea ServerStorage/DeliveryModels con un
--    Model vacío por entidad. Pon tu modelo de la Toolbox (o tuyo) dentro
--    del que corresponda; mientras estén vacíos, el juego usa bloques
--    placeholder que aluden a cada cosa. Ver README sección 6.
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local templates = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("DeliveryModels")
if not templates then
	templates = Instance.new("Folder")
	templates.Name = "DeliveryModels"
	templates.Parent = ServerStorage
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Dog", "Thief", "Drone", "Chicken", "Anomaly", "TrafficCar", "Bike", "Scooter", "Moto", "Car", "Package", "Crate" }) do
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = name
		m.Parent = templates
	end
end

-- 💥 golpes fuertes → paquetes explosivos/frágiles
PackageEffects.OnHardHit = function(player)
	DeliveryService.RegisterHit(player)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Conectar prompts de la ciudad
------------------------------------------------------------
local function wirePrompt(part, callback)
	local prompt = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = part
	end
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(callback)
end

local function wireByTag(tag, callback)
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			wirePrompt(inst, callback)
		end
	end
end

-- 📦 tienda: nueva entrega
wireByTag("DeliveryShopPad", function(player)
	DeliveryService.Assign(player)
end)
local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryPad")
if pad and pad:IsA("BasePart") then
	wirePrompt(pad, function(player) DeliveryService.Assign(player) end)
end

-- 🛠️ tienda de mejoras
wireByTag("DeliveryUpgradePad", function(player)
	Remotes.OpenShop:FireClient(player)
end)
local upad = workspace:FindFirstChild("UpgradePad")
if upad and upad:IsA("BasePart") then
	wirePrompt(upad, function(player) Remotes.OpenShop:FireClient(player) end)
end

-- 📍 destinos
local function wireDestination(part)
	wirePrompt(part, function(player)
		DeliveryService.TryDeliver(player, part)
	end)
end
for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("DeliveryDestination")) do
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		wireDestination(inst)
	end
end
local destFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Destinations")
if destFolder then
	for _, part in ipairs(destFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			wireDestination(part)
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Remotes cliente ↔ servidor
------------------------------------------------------------
Remotes.Sprint.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, flag)
	UpgradeService.SetSprinting(player, flag)
end)

Remotes.PurchaseUpgrade.OnServerInvoke = function(player, id)
	return UpgradeService.Purchase(player, id)
end

Remotes.PurchaseVehicle.OnServerInvoke = function(player, id)
	return VehicleService.Purchase(player, id)
end

Remotes.SpawnVehicle.OnServerInvoke = function(player, id)
	return VehicleService.Spawn(player, id)
end

Remotes.GetState.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return {
		Data = EconomyService.GetData(player),
		Upgrades = Config.Upgrades,
		UpgradeOrder = Config.UpgradeOrder,
		Vehicles = Config.Vehicles,
		VehicleOrder = Config.VehicleOrder,
	}
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ciclo de vida de jugadores
------------------------------------------------------------
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	EconomyService.LoadPlayer(player)
	UpgradeService.InitPlayer(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		DeliveryService.Cleanup(player) -- cancela entrega si murió a mitad
		task.wait(0.1)
		UpgradeService.ApplyCharacter(player)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do -- por si el script carga después (Studio)
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	DeliveryService.Cleanup(player)
	VehicleService.Cleanup(player)
	HazardService.Cleanup(player)
	UpgradeService.Cleanup(player)
	EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	EconomyService.UnloadPlayer(player)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	EconomyService.SaveAll()
	task.wait(1)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Bucles del juego
------------------------------------------------------------
UpgradeService.Start()   -- stamina y velocidad
EventService.Start()     -- 🌀 eventos ocasionales
HazardService.Start()    -- 👾 peligros ocasionales

print("[Delivery60] ¡Servidor listo! 📦")

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- MAP BUILDER · ciudad de prueba compacta autogenerada
-- Solo se construye si Config.AutoBuildTestMap = true y no existe
-- workspace.DeliveryCity. Para tu ciudad real, lee README.md
-- (basta con etiquetar tus partes con los mismos tags).
--============================================================
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local MapBuilder = {}

local function makePart(props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Size = props.Size
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame
	p.Name = props.Name or "Part"
	p.Transparency = props.Transparency or 0
	p.CanCollide = props.CanCollide
	if props.CanCollide == nil then p.CanCollide = true end
	p.Parent = props.Parent
	return p
end

local function addLabel(parent, text, yOffset)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 40)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, yOffset, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	lbl.Text = text
	lbl.TextScaled = true
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	lbl.Parent = bb
	bb.Parent = parent
end

local function addPrompt(part, actionText, objectText, hold)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = actionText
	prompt.ObjectText = objectText
	prompt.HoldDuration = hold or 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = part
	return prompt
end

function MapBuilder.Build()
	if not Config.AutoBuildTestMap then return end
	if workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryCity") then return end

	local city = Instance.new("Folder")
	city.Name = "DeliveryCity"
	city.Parent = workspace

	-- suelo (solo si la plantilla no trae baseplate)
	if not workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate") then
		makePart({
			Name = "Ground", Parent = city,
			Size = Vector3.new(520, 2, 520),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(118, 122, 128),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -1, 0),
			Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
		})
	end

	-- calles principales (cruz)
	makePart({ Name = "RoadH", Parent = city, Size = Vector3.new(500, 0.2, 18), Color = Color3.fromRGB(46, 48, 52), CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.06, 0) })
	makePart({ Name = "RoadV", Parent = city, Size = Vector3.new(18, 0.2, 500), Color = Color3.fromRGB(46, 48, 52), CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.06, 0) })

	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 📦 TIENDA DE ENVÍOS (origen de las entregas)
	------------------------------------------------------------
	makePart({ Name = "ShopPlatform", Parent = city, Size = Vector3.new(34, 1, 34), Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 205), CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -64) })
	local shop = makePart({ Name = "Shop", Parent = city, Size = Vector3.new(16, 10, 12), Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113), CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 6, -76) })
	addLabel(shop, "📦 TIENDA DE ENVÍOS", 8)
	local shopPad = makePart({
		Name = "DeliveryPad", Parent = city,
		Size = Vector3.new(8, 0.4, 8), Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 140),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 1.2, -58), Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
	})
	addPrompt(shopPad, "Recibir entrega", "📦 Tienda", 0)
	CollectionService:AddTag(shopPad, "DeliveryShopPad")

	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 🛠️ TIENDA DE MEJORAS Y VEHÍCULOS
	------------------------------------------------------------
	local upgradeShop = makePart({ Name = "UpgradeShop", Parent = city, Size = Vector3.new(12, 8, 10), Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 120, 200), CFrame = CFrame.new(26, 5, -74) })
	addLabel(upgradeShop, "🛠️ MEJORAS Y VEHÍCULOS", 7)
	local upgradePad = makePart({
		Name = "UpgradePad", Parent = city,
		Size = Vector3.new(8, 0.4, 8), Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 160, 255),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(26, 1.2, -58), Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
	})
	addPrompt(upgradePad, "Abrir tienda", "🛠️ Mejoras", 0)
	CollectionService:AddTag(upgradePad, "DeliveryUpgradePad")

	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 📍 DESTINOS (distritos del documento de diseño)
	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Flujo ordenado por anillos de distancia desde la tienda (0, -60):
	-- 🟢 cercano (~110-145 studs) · 🟡 medio (~155-165) · 🔴 lejano (~210-260)
	local destinations = {
		-- 🟢 anillo cercano
		{ Name = "🌳 Parque",            Pos = Vector3.new(-85, 0, 30),    Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 90),   Size = Vector3.new(20, 6, 20) },
		{ Name = "🏘️ Casa Azul",         Pos = Vector3.new(-50, 0, -160),  Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 220),  Size = Vector3.new(14, 10, 14) },
		{ Name = "🌉 Puente",            Pos = Vector3.new(100, 0, 45),    Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160), Size = Vector3.new(18, 8, 14) },
		-- 🟡 anillo medio
		{ Name = "🏠 Apartamento 204",   Pos = Vector3.new(-150, 0, -110), Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 120, 90),  Size = Vector3.new(16, 24, 16) },
		{ Name = "🏥 Hospital",          Pos = Vector3.new(150, 0, -120),  Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240), Size = Vector3.new(22, 18, 20) },
		{ Name = "🚉 Estación Central",  Pos = Vector3.new(175, 0, 60),    Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 110, 140),  Size = Vector3.new(26, 12, 18) },
		-- 🔴 anillo lejano
		{ Name = "🏢 Oficina Comercial", Pos = Vector3.new(-165, 0, 140),  Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 165, 200), Size = Vector3.new(18, 30, 18) },
		{ Name = "🏭 Fábrica",           Pos = Vector3.new(60, 0, 195),    Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 100, 95),  Size = Vector3.new(24, 14, 22) },
	}
	for _, d in ipairs(destinations) do
		local building = makePart({
			Name = d.Name .. "_edificio", Parent = city,
			Size = d.Size, Color = d.Color,
			CFrame = CFrame.new(d.Pos + Vector3.new(0, d.Size.Y / 2, 0)),
		})
		addLabel(building, d.Name, d.Size.Y / 2 + 3)
		-- zona de entrega frente al edificio
		local pad = makePart({
			Name = d.Name, Parent = city,
			Size = Vector3.new(7, 0.4, 7), Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(d.Pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, d.Size.Z / 2 + 7)),
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		})
		addPrompt(pad, "Entregar paquete", d.Name, 0.3)
		CollectionService:AddTag(pad, "DeliveryDestination")
	end

	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 💡 FAROLAS (las apaga el evento Blackout)
	------------------------------------------------------------
	for _, pos in ipairs({ Vector3.new(14, 0, 14), Vector3.new(-14, 0, 14), Vector3.new(14, 0, -14), Vector3.new(-14, 0, -14) }) do

	for _, pos in ipairs({ Vector3.new(70, 0, 70), Vector3.new(-80, 0, -50), Vector3.new(40, 0, -110), Vector3.new(-120, 0, 90) }) do

		})
		CollectionService:AddTag(node, "ConstructionNode")
	end

	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 🌀 PARADOX GATE: muro que bloquea un callejón (atajo)
	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- dos edificios que forman el callejón
	makePart({ Name = "AlleyL", Parent = city, Size = Vector3.new(14, 16, 22), Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 125, 120), CFrame = CFrame.new(24, 8, -18) })
	makePart({ Name = "AlleyR", Parent = city, Size = Vector3.new(14, 16, 22), Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 135, 130), CFrame = CFrame.new(44, 8, -18) })
	local gate = makePart({
		Name = "ParadoxGate", Parent = city,
		Size = Vector3.new(6, 12, 1.5), Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(34, 6, -18),
	})
	addLabel(gate, "🌀 ?", 8)
	CollectionService:AddTag(gate, "ParadoxGate")

	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 🚗 RUTAS DE TRÁFICO (evento Caos de tráfico)
	------------------------------------------------------------
	local traffic = Instance.new("Folder")
	traffic.Name = "TrafficPaths"
	traffic.Parent = workspace
	local function path(a, b)
		local f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Parent = traffic
		makePart({ Name = "A", Parent = f, Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame = CFrame.new(a), Transparency = 1, CanCollide = false })
		makePart({ Name = "B", Parent = f, Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame = CFrame.new(b), Transparency = 1, CanCollide = false })

	path(Vector3.new(5, 2, -240), Vector3.new(5, 2, 240))
	path(Vector3.new(-5, 2, -240), Vector3.new(-5, 2, 240))

	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 🏙️ Decoración: tejados con rampas (ruta rápida) y parque
	------------------------------------------------------------
	-- fila de tejados escalonados cerca del centro
	local roofY = { 5, 8, 11 }

		ramp.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete

		ramp.CFrame = CFrame.new(-30 - (i - 1) * 16 + 10, (y + prevY) / 2 - 0.5, 20 + (i - 1) * 4) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-90), 0)
		ramp.Parent = city
	end
	-- árboles del parque
	for _, pos in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-60, 0, 55), Vector3.new(-85, 0, 35), Vector3.new(-55, 0, 30) }) do

	end

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- PACKAGE EFFECTS · el paquete físico y los efectos de cada modificador
--  📦 Normal · 🐌 Pesado (vía SpeedMult) · 💣 Explosivo · 👀 Público
--  🦶 Sin salto · ❤️ Frágil · 🐔 Pollo (visibilidad) · 💰 Valioso
--
-- El VISUAL del paquete puede ser un modelo tuyo:
--   ServerStorage/DeliveryModels/Package_<Id>  (ej. Package_Explosive)
--   ServerStorage/DeliveryModels/Package       (genérico)
-- Si no hay plantilla, se usa un bloque placeholder de color.
--============================================================
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local PackageEffects = {}

-- Callback asignado por Main: se llama cuando el paquete recibe un golpe fuerte
PackageEffects.OnHardHit = nil -- function(player)

local active = {} -- [player] = { Part, Model, Weld, Billboard, ... }

local COLORS = {
	Normal = Color3.fromRGB(178, 132, 82),
	Heavy = Color3.fromRGB(120, 92, 60),
	Explosive = Color3.fromRGB(224, 82, 62),
	Public = Color3.fromRGB(245, 201, 79),
	NoJump = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 160),
	Fragile = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 175),
	Chicken = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 240),
	Valuable = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
}

local function getTorso(char)
	return char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- Visual del paquete: plantilla de modelo > malla importada > bloque
local function createVisual(pkg)
	-- 1) plantilla del usuario
	local templates = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("DeliveryModels")
	local template = templates and (templates:FindFirstChild("Package_" .. pkg.Id) or templates:FindFirstChild("Package"))
	if template and template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
		local model = template:Clone()
		PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.Anchored = false
				d.CanCollide = false
				d.Massless = true
			end
		end
		PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model, true)
		return model, model.PrimaryPart
	end
	-- 2) malla importada (Config.PackageMeshId)
	if Config.PackageMeshId ~= "" then
		local mesh = Instance.new("MeshPart")
		mesh.MeshId = Config.PackageMeshId
		mesh.Size = Vector3.new(2.6, 3.2, 1.8)
		return nil, mesh
	end
	-- 3) bloque placeholder
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
	part.Color = COLORS[pkg.Id] or COLORS.Normal
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	return nil, part
end

function PackageEffects.FireHit(player)
	if PackageEffects.OnHardHit then
		PackageEffects.OnHardHit(player)
	end
end

function PackageEffects.Attach(player, pkg)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	PackageEffects.Detach(player)
	local torso = getTorso(char)
	if not torso then return end

	local model, root = createVisual(pkg)
	root.Name = "DeliveryPackage"
	root.CanCollide = false
	root.Massless = true
	root.CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 1.15)

	-- etiqueta flotante con el icono del paquete
	local bb = root:FindFirstChild("Icon")
	if not bb then
		bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Name = "Icon"
		bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42)
		bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0)
		bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		lbl.Text = pkg.Icon
		lbl.TextScaled = true
		lbl.Parent = bb
		bb.Parent = root
	end

	local container = model or root
	container.Parent = char

	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = torso
	weld.Part1 = root
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 1.15)
	weld.Parent = root

	local data = { Part = root, Model = model, Weld = weld, Billboard = bb, Package = pkg }
	active[player] = data

	-- 👀 PÚBLICO: todos pueden ver quién lleva el paquete
	if pkg.Id == "Public" then
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = "PublicHighlight"
		hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 70)
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 170)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.75
		hl.Parent = char
		data.Highlight = hl
	end

	-- 🦶 SIN SALTO
	if pkg.Id == "NoJump" then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower = 0
		end
	end

	-- detección de golpes para 💣 Explosivo y ❤️ Frágil
	if pkg.Id == "Explosive" or pkg.Id == "Fragile" then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hum and hrp then
			local lastVy = 0
			data.Heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if hrp.Parent then
					lastVy = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
				end
			end)
			data.Connections = {
				hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
					if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed and lastVy < -Config.HardFallVelocity then
						PackageEffects.FireHit(player)
					end
				end),
				root.Touched:Connect(function(other)
					if data.HitDebounce and os.clock() - data.HitDebounce < 0.6 then return end
					local ok, mag = pcall(function()
						return other.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
					end)
					if ok and mag and mag > Config.HardHitVelocity then
						data.HitDebounce = os.clock()
						PackageEffects.FireHit(player)
					end
				end),
			}
		end
	end
end

function PackageEffects.Detach(player)
	local data = active[player]
	if not data then return end
	if data.Connections then
		for _, c in ipairs(data.Connections) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	if data.Heartbeat then data.Heartbeat:Disconnect() end
	if data.RecoverConn then data.RecoverConn:Disconnect() end
	if data.Highlight then data.Highlight:Destroy() end
	if data.Model then data.Model:Destroy() end
	if data.Part then data.Part:Destroy() end
	active[player] = nil
	-- restaurar salto
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and hum.JumpPower == 0 then
		hum.JumpPower = 50
	end
end

-- Suelta el paquete al suelo; se recoge con ProximityPrompt (solo el dueño)
function PackageEffects.DropToGround(player, onRecover)
	local data = active[player]
	if not data or not data.Part then return end
	local root = data.Part
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if data.Weld then
		data.Weld:Destroy()
		data.Weld = nil
	end
	local container = data.Model or root
	container.Parent = workspace
	root.CanCollide = true
	root.Massless = false
	if hrp then
		root.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -3.5)
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
	end

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Recoger paquete"
	prompt.ObjectText = "📦 Tu paquete"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.2
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = root
	data.Prompt = prompt

	data.RecoverConn = prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
		if p ~= player then return end
		if data.Weld then return end -- ya recogido
		prompt:Destroy()
		local c = player.Character
		local torso = c and getTorso(c)
		if not torso then return end
		root.CanCollide = false
		root.Massless = true
		root.CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 1.15)
		local cont = data.Model or root
		cont.Parent = c
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Part0 = torso
		weld.Part1 = root
		weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 1.15)
		weld.Parent = root
		data.Weld = weld
		onRecover()
	end)
end

function PackageEffects.SetPackageVisible(player, visible)
	local data = active[player]
	if not data or not data.Part then return end
	if data.Model then
		if not visible then
			data.SavedTrans = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(data.Model:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					data.SavedTrans[d] = d.Transparency
					d.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
		elseif data.SavedTrans then
			for d, t in pairs(data.SavedTrans) do
				if d.Parent then d.Transparency = t end
			end
			data.SavedTrans = nil
		end
	else
		data.Part.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
	end
	if data.Billboard then
		data.Billboard.Enabled = visible
	end
end

function PackageEffects.Explode(player)
	local data = active[player]
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pos = (data and data.Part and data.Part.Position) or (hrp and hrp.Position)
	if pos then
		local ex = Instance.new("Explosion")
		ex.Position = pos
		ex.BlastRadius = 10
		ex.BlastPressure = 250000
		ex.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0 -- no romper el mapa
		ex.Parent = workspace
	end
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum:TakeDamage(60)
	end
end

function PackageEffects.GetPart(player)
	local data = active[player]
	return data and data.Part or nil
end

return PackageEffects

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- PLACEHOLDER BUILDER · bloques temporales que "aluden" a cada entidad
-- Se usan cuando un modelo de ServerStorage/DeliveryModels está vacío
-- o cuando el juego genera la entidad en runtime sin plantilla.
-- Cuando pongas tu modelo 3D real (Toolbox o tuyo), esto NO se ejecuta.
--============================================================
local PlaceholderBuilder = {}

local function part(model, size, color, offset, shape)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	if shape then p.Shape = shape end
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = true        -- los peligros se mueven con PivotTo (CFrame)
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CFrame = offset        -- posición local (el spawner posiciona después)
	p.Parent = model
	return p
end

local function icon(primary, emoji, yOff)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "Icon"
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, yOff, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = "Label"
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	l.Text = emoji
	l.TextScaled = true
	l.Parent = bb
	bb.Parent = primary
end

-- Elige PrimaryPart si el modelo no tiene: la parte de mayor volumen
function PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
	if model.PrimaryPart then return end
	local best, bestVol
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v = d.Size.X * d.Size.Y * d.Size.Z
			if not bestVol or v > bestVol then
				best, bestVol = d, v
			end
		end
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = best
end

-- Suelda TODAS las partes al PrimaryPart (rígido, conserva offsets actuales)
function PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model, makeMassless)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then return end
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= root then
			local has = false
			for _, w in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				if w:IsA("WeldConstraint") and w.Part1 == d then
					has = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not has then
				local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				w.Part0 = root
				w.Part1 = d
				w.Parent = root
			end
			if makeMassless then
				d.Massless = true
			end
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Constructores de placeholders (frente del modelo = -Z)
------------------------------------------------------------
local builders = {}

-- 🐕 Perro
builders.Dog = function(model)
	local brown = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70)
	local darkB = Color3.fromRGB(120, 88, 55)
	local body = part(model, Vector3.new(2.2, 1.8, 3.6), brown, CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0))
	part(model, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6), brown, CFrame.new(0, 2.6, -2.4))  -- cabeza
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.9, 0.4), darkB, CFrame.new(-0.5, 3.7, -2.4)) -- orejas
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.9, 0.4), darkB, CFrame.new(0.5, 3.7, -2.4))
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 1.4), darkB, CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 2.4))    -- cola
	for _, o in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-0.7, 0.6, -1.2), Vector3.new(0.7, 0.6, -1.2), Vector3.new(-0.7, 0.6, 1.2), Vector3.new(0.7, 0.6, 1.2) }) do
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.2, 0.5), darkB, CFrame.new(o))            -- patas
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	icon(body, "🐕", 3)
	PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model)
end

-- 🦹 Ladrón
builders.Thief = function(model)
	local dark = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
	local skin = Color3.fromRGB(220, 190, 160)
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.8, 1.6, 1), dark, CFrame.new(-0.55, 0.8, 0))      -- piernas
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.8, 1.6, 1), dark, CFrame.new(0.55, 0.8, 0))
	local torso = part(model, Vector3.new(2, 2.4, 1.2), dark, CFrame.new(0, 2.8, 0))
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.6, 2, 0.6), dark, CFrame.new(-1.3, 2.8, 0))       -- brazos
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.6, 2, 0.6), dark, CFrame.new(1.3, 2.8, 0))
	part(model, Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), skin, CFrame.new(0, 4.75, 0))       -- cabeza
	part(model, Vector3.new(1.6, 0.5, 0.2), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25), CFrame.new(0, 4.9, -0.72)) -- antifaz
	model.PrimaryPart = torso
	icon(torso, "🦹", 4)
	PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model)
end

-- 🚁 Drone
builders.Drone = function(model)
	local dark = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85)
	local body = part(model, Vector3.new(2.4, 0.6, 2.4), dark, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))
	for _, o in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-1.4, 0.35, -1.4), Vector3.new(1.4, 0.35, -1.4), Vector3.new(-1.4, 0.35, 1.4), Vector3.new(1.4, 0.35, 1.4) }) do
		part(model, Vector3.new(1.3, 0.12, 0.25), dark, CFrame.new(o))            -- hélices
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.12, 1.3), dark, CFrame.new(o))
	end
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Range = 8
	light.Brightness = 1
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 110)
	light.Parent = body
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	icon(body, "🚁", 2.5)
	PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model)
end

-- 🐔 Pollo
builders.Chicken = function(model)
	local white = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 240)
	local body = part(model, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.4, 2), white, CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0))
	part(model, Vector3.new(1.1, 1.1, 1.1), white, CFrame.new(0, 2.4, -1.3))    -- cabeza
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.7, 0.5, 0.25), Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 55), CFrame.new(0, 3.1, -1.3))  -- cresta
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.35, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 60), CFrame.new(0, 2.35, -2.05)) -- pico
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.6, 0.25), Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 60), CFrame.new(-0.4, 0.3, 0))
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.6, 0.25), Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 60), CFrame.new(0.4, 0.3, 0))
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	icon(body, "🐔", 2.6)
	PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model)
end

-- 👻 Anomalía
builders.Anomaly = function(model)
	local core = part(model, Vector3.new(3.4, 3.4, 3.4), Color3.fromRGB(45, 30, 70), CFrame.new(0, 3, 0))
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 200), CFrame.new(2.6, 3.8, 0))
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 200), CFrame.new(-2.6, 2.4, 0))
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 90, 255)
	light.Range = 24
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Parent = core
	model.PrimaryPart = core
	icon(core, "👻", 4)
	PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model)
end

-- 🚗 Coche de tráfico (evento Caos de tráfico)

local function vpart(model, size, color, offset, shape)
	local p = part(model, size, color, offset, shape)
	p.Anchored = false
	p.CanCollide = true
	return p
end

local function buildVehicle(model, id)
	local dark = Color3.fromRGB(38, 40, 46)
	local accent = {
		Bike = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
		Scooter = Color3.fromRGB(90, 159, 232),

		Car = Color3.fromRGB(234, 194, 107),

	elseif id == "Scooter" then
		chassis = vpart(model, Vector3.new(1.4, 0.5, 4.6), color, CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 0))
		seatOffset = CFrame.new(0, 1.9, 0.8)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(2, 0.4, 0.4), dark, CFrame.new(0, 2.6, -1.9))
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.8, 1.8), dark, CFrame.new(0, 0.9, -1.9), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.8, 1.8), dark, CFrame.new(0, 0.9, 1.9), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	elseif id == "Moto" then
		chassis = vpart(model, Vector3.new(1.6, 1, 6), color, CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0))
		seatOffset = CFrame.new(0, 2.4, 0.9)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(2.4, 0.4, 0.4), dark, CFrame.new(0, 3, -2.4))
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.7, 2.6, 2.6), dark, CFrame.new(0, 1.3, -2.4), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.7, 2.6, 2.6), dark, CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 2.4), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	else -- Car
		chassis = vpart(model, Vector3.new(4.5, 1.2, 9), color, CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0))
		seatOffset = CFrame.new(0, 2.5, -1)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(3.8, 1.4, 4.5), Color3.fromRGB(180, 210, 230), CFrame.new(0, 2.9, 0.6))
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.9, 2.4, 2.4), dark, CFrame.new(-1.9, 1.2, -3.2), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.9, 2.4, 2.4), dark, CFrame.new(1.9, 1.2, -3.2), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.9, 2.4, 2.4), dark, CFrame.new(-1.9, 1.2, 3.2), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		vpart(model, Vector3.new(0.9, 2.4, 2.4), dark, CFrame.new(1.9, 1.2, 3.2), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	end

	local seat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat")
	seat.Name = "DriveSeat"
	seat.Size = (id == "Car") and Vector3.new(2.2, 0.6, 2) or Vector3.new(1.6, 0.5, 1.8)
	seat.Color = dark
	seat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	seat.Anchored = false
	seat.CFrame = seatOffset
	seat.Parent = model

	model.PrimaryPart = chassis
	PlaceholderBuilder.WeldAll(model)
end

-- Punto de entrada: construye el placeholder del tipo indicado
function PlaceholderBuilder.Build(kind, model)
	if kind == "Bike" or kind == "Scooter" or kind == "Moto" or kind == "Car" then
		buildVehicle(model, kind)
		return
	end
	local fn = builders[kind]

	else

		local p = part(model, Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 155), CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0))
		model.PrimaryPart = p
		icon(p, "❓", 3)
	end
	PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
end

return PlaceholderBuilder

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- UPGRADE SERVICE · mejoras, velocidad, sprint y stamina
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local EconomyService = require(script.Parent.EconomyService)

local UpgradeService = {}

-- stamina por jugador: [userId] = { Value, Sprinting, LastDrain }
local stamina = {}
local lastAppliedSpeed = {} -- [userId] = número aplicado por última vez

function UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, upgradeId)
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	if not data then return 0 end
	return data.Upgrades[upgradeId] or 0
end

function UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player)
	return Config.StaminaMax + 20 * UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Stamina")
end

function UpgradeService.GetBaseSpeed(player)
	return Config.BaseWalkSpeed + 1.5 * UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Speed")
end

-- Velocidad efectiva: base × modificador del paquete + sprint
function UpgradeService.EffectiveSpeed(player)
	local mult = player:GetAttribute("SpeedMult") or 1
	local speed = UpgradeService.GetBaseSpeed(player)
	local st = stamina[player.UserId]
	if st and st.Sprinting and st.Value > 0 then
		speed += Config.SprintBoost
	end
	return speed * mult
end

function UpgradeService.InitPlayer(player)
	stamina[player.UserId] = { Value = UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player), Sprinting = false, LastDrain = 0 }
	player:SetAttribute("Stamina", stamina[player.UserId].Value)
	player:SetAttribute("StaminaMax", UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player))
	player:SetAttribute("GPSLevel", UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "GPS"))
	player:SetAttribute("SpeedMult", 1)
end

function UpgradeService.ApplyCharacter(player)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	hum.UseJumpPower = true
	hum.JumpPower = 50
	hum.WalkSpeed = UpgradeService.EffectiveSpeed(player)
	lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] = hum.WalkSpeed
end

function UpgradeService.SetSprinting(player, flag)
	local st = stamina[player.UserId]
	if st then
		st.Sprinting = flag == true
	end
end

-- Bucle global: drena/regenera stamina y aplica la velocidad
function UpgradeService.Start()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local st = stamina[player.UserId]
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if st and hum then
				local maxSt = UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player)
				local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
				if st.Sprinting and st.Value > 0 and moving then
					st.Value = math.max(0, st.Value - Config.StaminaDrain * dt)
					st.LastDrain = os.clock()
					if st.Value <= 0 then
						st.Sprinting = false
					end
				elseif os.clock() - st.LastDrain > Config.StaminaRegenDelay then
					st.Value = math.min(maxSt, st.Value + Config.StaminaRegen * dt)
				end
				-- atributos para el HUD (solo cuando cambia el entero)
				local shown = math.floor(st.Value + 0.5)
				if player:GetAttribute("Stamina") ~= shown then
					player:SetAttribute("Stamina", shown)
				end
				if player:GetAttribute("StaminaMax") ~= maxSt then
					player:SetAttribute("StaminaMax", maxSt)
				end
				-- aplicar velocidad solo cuando cambia
				local speed = UpgradeService.EffectiveSpeed(player)
				if lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] ~= speed then
					hum.WalkSpeed = speed
					lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] = speed
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Compra de mejoras (validación en servidor)
function UpgradeService.Purchase(player, upgradeId)
	local def = Config.Upgrades[upgradeId]
	if not def then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Mejora desconocida" }
	end
	local level = UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, upgradeId)
	if level >= def.MaxLevel then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Nivel máximo alcanzado" }
	end
	local cost = def.Costs[level + 1]
	if not EconomyService.SpendMoney(player, cost) then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Dinero insuficiente ($" .. cost .. ")" }
	end
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	data.Upgrades[upgradeId] = level + 1
	EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	if upgradeId == "GPS" then
		player:SetAttribute("GPSLevel", level + 1)
	end
	if upgradeId == "Stamina" then
		local st = stamina[player.UserId]
		if st then
			player:SetAttribute("StaminaMax", UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player))
		end
	end
	return { Ok = true, Msg = def.Name .. " → nivel " .. (level + 1), Level = level + 1 }
end

function UpgradeService.Cleanup(player)
	stamina[player.UserId] = nil
	lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] = nil
end

return UpgradeService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- VEHICLE SERVICE · compra y generación de vehículos
-- 🚲 Bici · 🛴 Scooter · 🏍️ Moto · 🚗 Coche
--
-- Cada vehículo es un MODELO (ServerStorage/DeliveryModels/<Id>)
-- con el comportamiento Behaviors/Vehicle. Si la plantilla no existe

--============================================================
local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local Server = script.Parent
local EconomyService = require(Server.EconomyService)
local EntitySpawner = require(Server.EntitySpawner)

local VehicleService = {}

local function vehiclesFolder()
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryVehicles")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "DeliveryVehicles"
		folder.Parent = workspace
	end
	return folder
end

function VehicleService.GetPlayerVehicle(player)
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryVehicles")
	if not folder then return nil end
	for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then
			return m
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Compra (RemoteFunction)
function VehicleService.Purchase(player, vehicleId)
	local def = Config.Vehicles[vehicleId]
	if not def then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Vehículo desconocido" }
	end
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Datos no cargados" }
	end
	if data.Vehicles[vehicleId] then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Ya lo tienes" }
	end
	if not EconomyService.SpendMoney(player, def.Price) then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Dinero insuficiente ($" .. def.Price .. ")" }
	end
	data.Vehicles[vehicleId] = true
	EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	return { Ok = true, Msg = def.Name .. " comprado" }
end

-- Generar vehículo junto al jugador (RemoteFunction)
function VehicleService.Spawn(player, vehicleId)
	local def = Config.Vehicles[vehicleId]
	if not def then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Vehículo desconocido" }
	end
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	if not data or not data.Vehicles[vehicleId] then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "No tienes este vehículo" }
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Personaje no disponible" }
	end

	-- destruir el vehículo anterior del jugador
	local old = VehicleService.GetPlayerVehicle(player)
	if old then old:Destroy() end

	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn(vehicleId, {
		MaxSpeed = def.MaxSpeed,
		Torque = def.Torque,
		TurnSpeed = def.TurnSpeed,
		OwnerUserId = player.UserId,
	}, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(7, 3, 0))
	model.Parent = vehiclesFolder()
	return { Ok = true, Msg = def.Name .. " listo" }
end

function VehicleService.Cleanup(player)
	local v = VehicleService.GetPlayerVehicle(player)
	if v then v:Destroy() end
end

return VehicleService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 👻 ANOMALY (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- Persigue al repartidor activo más cercano (lee el atributo
-- DeliveryState de cada jugador). Al alcanzarlo, lo notifica,
-- retrocede y sigue acechando hasta que acaba LifeTime.
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA: Speed · CatchDist · LifeTime
-- Atributos de SALIDA: CaughtUserId + CaughtTick (por cada golpe)
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Anomaly = {}

local function rootPos(player)
	local char = player and player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

function Anomaly.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Anomaly", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 24
	local catchDist = model:GetAttribute("CatchDist") or 4.5
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 30

	local t0 = os.clock()
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		if os.clock() - t0 > life then break end

		-- repartidor activo más cercano
		local bestPlayer, bestDist
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local state = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryState")
			if state and state ~= "None" then
				local pos = rootPos(player)
				if pos then
					local d = (pos - root.Position).Magnitude
					if not bestDist or d < bestDist then
						bestDist = d
						bestPlayer = player
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local target = bestPlayer and rootPos(bestPlayer)
		if target then
			local pos = root.Position
			local goal = Vector3.new(target.X, pos.Y, target.Z)
			local delta = goal - pos
			local d = delta.Magnitude
			if d < catchDist then
				-- golpe: notifica y retrocede
				model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", bestPlayer.UserId)
				model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos - delta.Unit * 10))
			else
				local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, d)
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, goal))
			end
		end
	end

	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Anomaly

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🐔 CHICKEN (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- El pollo escapado: salta por los alrededores hasta que su dueño
-- lo atrapa con el ProximityPrompt "Atrapar pollo".
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA: TargetUserId · LifeTime (s)
-- Atributos de SALIDA: CaughtUserId + CaughtTick
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Chicken = {}

local rng = Random.new()

function Chicken.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Chicken", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	local waited = os.clock()
	while not userId and os.clock() - waited < 5 do
		task.wait()
		userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	end
	if not userId then model:Destroy() return end

	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 40

	-- prompt para atraparlo (solo el dueño)
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Atrapar pollo"
		prompt.ObjectText = "🐔 Pollo escapado"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.1
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = root
	end
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
		if p.UserId ~= userId then return end
		if model:GetAttribute("CaughtTick") then return end
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", p.UserId)
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
	end)

	-- saltos aleatorios cerca del punto de escape
	local home = root.Position
	local nextHop = 0
	local hopTarget = home
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		if model:GetAttribute("CaughtTick") then break end
		if os.clock() - t0 > life then break end
		if os.clock() >= nextHop then
			nextHop = os.clock() + 0.8
			local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
			local dist = rng:NextNumber(4, 20)
			hopTarget = home + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, 0, math.sin(angle) * dist)
		end
		local pos = root.Position
		local goal = Vector3.new(hopTarget.X, home.Y, hopTarget.Z)
		local delta = goal - pos
		local d = delta.Magnitude
		if d > 1 then
			local hop = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 6)) * 4
			local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * math.min(10 * dt, d) + Vector3.new(0, hop * dt, 0)
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, goal))
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.2)
	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Chicken

-- Persigue al jugador objetivo; al alcanzarlo lo notifica por atributos.
--

--   TargetUserId (number) · Speed (studs/s) · CatchDist · LifeTime (s)

		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Dog", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	-- esperar el objetivo (el spawner lo fija antes de parentar)
	local userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	local waited = os.clock()
	while not userId and os.clock() - waited < 5 do
		task.wait()
		userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	end
	local player = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)

	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 22
	local catchDist = model:GetAttribute("CatchDist") or 3.5
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 18
