		local target = rootPos(player)
		if target then
			local pos = root.Position
			local goal = Vector3.new(target.X, pos.Y, target.Z)
			local delta = goal - pos
			local d = delta.Magnitude
			if d < catchDist then
				caught = true
				break

			local step = math.min(speed * dt, d)
			local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * step
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, goal))
		end
	end

	if caught and model.Parent then
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", player.UserId)
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Drone", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	local waited = os.clock()
	while not userId and os.clock() - waited < 5 do
		task.wait()
		userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	end
	local player = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if not player then model:Destroy() return end

	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 30
	local catchDist = model:GetAttribute("CatchDist") or 4
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 12

	local t0 = os.clock()
	local caught = false
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		local elapsed = os.clock() - t0
		if elapsed > life then break end
		local target = rootPos(player)
		if target then
			-- 3 s de vigilancia desde arriba, luego picado
			local goal = target + (elapsed < 3 and Vector3.new(0, 10, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
			local pos = root.Position
			local delta = goal - pos
			local d = delta.Magnitude
			if elapsed >= 3 and d < catchDist then
				caught = true
				break
			end
			local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, d)
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(newPos))
		end
	end

	if caught and model.Parent then
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", player.UserId)
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Drone

items.source:
--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🚗 TRAFFIC CAR (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- Va y viene entre dos puntos (evento Caos de tráfico).
-- Al tocar a un jugador lo notifica (con anti-spam por jugador).
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA:
--   WaypointA / WaypointB (Vector3) · Speed · LifeTime (s)
-- Atributos de SALIDA: CaughtUserId + CaughtTick (por cada golpe)
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local TrafficCar = {}

local rng = Random.new()

function TrafficCar.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("TrafficCar", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local a = model:GetAttribute("WaypointA")
	local b = model:GetAttribute("WaypointB")
	if typeof(a) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(b) ~= "Vector3" then
		model:Destroy()
		return
	end
	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 32
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 40

	-- golpear al tocar (anti-spam 1.2 s por jugador)
	local lastHit = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local hum = hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local plr = hum and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if plr then
					local now = os.clock()
					if not lastHit[plr.UserId] or now - lastHit[plr.UserId] > 1.2 then
						lastHit[plr.UserId] = now
						model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", plr.UserId)
						model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", now)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	-- ida y vuelta entre A y B
	local t = rng:NextNumber()
	local dir = 1
	local length = (b - a).Magnitude
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		if os.clock() - t0 > life then break end
		t += dir * dt * (speed / math.max(length, 1))
		if t >= 1 then t = 1 dir = -1 end
		if t <= 0 then t = 0 dir = 1 end
		local pos = a:Lerp(b, t)
		local face = (b - a).Unit * dir
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + face))
	end

	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return TrafficCar

items.source:
--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🚲 VEHICLE (comportamiento autocontenido · sirve para Bike,
-- Scooter, Moto y Car; la configuración llega por atributos)
--
-- Prepara CUALQUIER modelo para conducirse:
--   · si está vacío → bloques placeholder (con VehicleSeat)
--   · si tu modelo no trae VehicleSeat → crea uno soldado encima
--   · suelta (desancla) todas las partes y las suelda al PrimaryPart
--   · aplica MaxSpeed/Torque/TurnSpeed y asigna el dueño de red
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA: MaxSpeed · Torque · TurnSpeed · OwnerUserId
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Vehicle = {}

function Vehicle.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	-- placeholder si está vacío (según el NOMBRE del modelo: Bike/Scooter/Moto/Car)
	if not model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
		PlaceholderBuilder.Build(model.Name, model)
	end
	PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	-- asiento de conducción
	local seat = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
	if not seat then
		seat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat")
		seat.Name = "DriveSeat"
		seat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 2)
		seat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 40, 46)
		seat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		local extents = model:GetExtentsSize()
		seat.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, extents.Y / 2 + 0.6, 0)
		seat.Parent = model
	end
	seat.MaxSpeed = model:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed") or 32
	seat.Torque = model:GetAttribute("Torque") or 2
	seat.TurnSpeed = model:GetAttribute("TurnSpeed") or 2.5
	seat.Disabled = false

	-- soldar todo rígido al PrimaryPart y desanclar
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			if d ~= root then
				local has = false
				for _, w in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
					if w:IsA("WeldConstraint") and w.Part1 == d then
						has = true
						break
					end
				end
				if not has then
					local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
					w.Part0 = root
					w.Part1 = d
					w.Parent = root
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- dueño de red para conducción fluida
	local ownerId = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	local owner = ownerId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId)
	if owner then
		pcall(function()
			root:SetNetworkOwner(owner)
		end)
	end
end

return Vehicle
